title: Present perfect continuous and simple (I have been doing and I have done)
titleId: Kegiatan vs. hasil (have been doing / have done)

cards.text: have been -ing memusatkan perhatian pada kegiatannya (mungkin belum selesai). have done memusatkan perhatian pada hasil yang sudah selesai.

examples.id: Saya habis mengecat kamar (ada cat di baju, mungkin belum selesai).

cards.text: Untuk "berapa lama" (how long, for, since, all morning) pakai continuous. Untuk "berapa banyak / berapa kali" (how much, how many, three times) pakai simple.

examples.en: Amel has been writing emails all morning.

cards.text: Kata kerja keadaan seperti know, dan have yang berarti "punya", tetap memakai bentuk simple.

examples.en: How long have you had that phone?
examples.id: Sudah berapa lama kamu punya HP itu?

cards.trap: Bukan I've been knowing atau have you been having.

questions.prompt: My little brother ___ all the cake! There is nothing left.
questions.why: Yang penting hasilnya: kuenya sudah habis. Jadi present perfect simple: has eaten.

questions.prompt: How many pages ___ (you / read) so far?
questions.why: Menanyakan berapa banyak (how many) memakai present perfect simple.

questions.prompt: I've been knowing Dian for ten years.
questions.answer: I have known Dian for ten years.
questions.why: know adalah kata kerja keadaan, jadi pakai present perfect simple.

questions.prompt: My hands are dirty. I've ___ repairing my car.
questions.why: Hasil kegiatan terlihat (tangan kotor), fokus pada kegiatannya: have been + -ing.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Sudah berapa kali kamu mengunjungi Bali?"
questions.answer: How many times have you visited Bali?
questions.why: Menanyakan berapa kali memakai present perfect simple: How many times + have + you + past participle.

questions.prompt: Sari is tired. She ___ (clean) the house all morning.
questions.why: Lamanya kegiatan (all morning) memakai present perfect continuous.

pairs: Why is there paint on your shirt?
How long have you been learning Korean?
How many words have you learnt?
questions.why: Kegiatan dan lamanya memakai have been -ing; hasil selesai dan jumlah memakai have done.

questions.source: Saya sudah menulis tiga surat hari ini.
questions.answer: I have written three letters today
questions.why: Jumlah yang sudah selesai (tiga surat) memakai present perfect simple: have written.
have yang berarti "punya" tidak dipakai dalam bentuk continuous.

questions.prompt: Rudi has been sending 50 messages this morning.
questions.answer: Rudi has sent 50 messages this morning.
questions.why: Jumlah yang sudah selesai (50 pesan) memakai present perfect simple.
